{
  "name": "travel-ai-decision-engine",
  "version": "0.8.0",
  "private": true,
  "engines": {
    "node": "22.x"
  },
  "scripts": {
    "dev": "node scripts/next-dev.mjs",
    "build": "node scripts/build-with-vercel-bootstrap.mjs",
    "start": "next start",
    "typecheck": "tsc --noEmit",
    "test:v8": "node --import tsx scripts/v8-matcher-smoke.ts",
    "test:v9": "node --import tsx scripts/v9-continuity-smoke.ts",
    "test:v10": "node --import tsx scripts/v10-scenario-suite.ts",
    "test:population": "node --import tsx scripts/v10-population-suite.ts",
    "test:audit:10000": "node --import tsx scripts/v10-10000-audit.ts",
    "test:availability": "node --import tsx scripts/stay-availability-smoke.ts",
    "test:charging": "node --import tsx scripts/ev-charging-smoke.ts",
    "test:result-auditor": "node --import tsx scripts/result-auditor-smoke.ts",
    "test:geo-composition": "node --import tsx scripts/geography-composition-smoke.ts",
    "test:research-scout": "node --import tsx scripts/research-scout-smoke.ts",
    "test:stay-cities": "node --import tsx scripts/stay-city-inventory-smoke.ts",

    "test:v25:trip-builder": "node --import tsx scripts/v25-trip-builder-smoke.ts",
    "test:v26:criteria": "node --import tsx scripts/v26-criterion-combinations.ts",
    "test:v29:seo": "node --import tsx scripts/v29-seo-agent-smoke.ts",
    "test:v30:location-map": "node --import tsx scripts/v30-location-map-smoke.ts",
    "test:v31:webflow": "node --import tsx scripts/v31-webflow-smoke.ts",
    "test:v31:native": "node --import tsx scripts/v31-native-production-smoke.ts",
    "test:v32:product-map": "node --import tsx scripts/v32-multipage-product-map-smoke.ts",
    "test:v34:semantic": "node --import tsx scripts/v34-semantic-funnel-smoke.ts",
    "test:v36:bidirectional": "node --import tsx scripts/v36-bidirectional-funnel-smoke.ts",
    "test:v37:100": "node --import tsx scripts/v37-100-live-agent-scenarios.ts",
    "test:v38:cinematic": "node --import tsx scripts/v38-cinematic-360-smoke.ts",
    "test:v39:map-review": "node --import tsx scripts/v39-map-review-smoke.ts",
    "test:v40:experience": "node --import tsx scripts/v40-agent-experience-smoke.ts",
    "test:strict": "npm run test:v8 && npm run test:v9 && npm run test:v10 && npm run test:population && npm run test:audit:10000 && npm run test:availability && npm run test:charging && npm run test:result-auditor && npm run test:geo-composition && npm run test:research-scout && npm run test:stay-cities && npm run test:v15:architecture && npm run test:v15:greeklish && npm run test:v15:1000 && npm run test:v16:stay && npm run test:v16:router && npm run test:v16:stay1000 && npm run test:v17:choice1000 && npm run test:v18:semantic && npm run test:v19:match10000 && npm run test:v20:truth && npm run test:v21:choice && npm run test:v22:criterion && npm run test:v25:trip-builder && npm run test:v26:criteria && npm run test:v29:seo && npm run test:v30:location-map && npm run test:v31:webflow && npm run test:v31:native && npm run test:v32:product-map && npm run test:v34:semantic && npm run test:v36:bidirectional && npm run test:v37:100 && npm run test:v38:cinematic && npm run test:v39:map-review && npm run test:v40:experience && npm run test:v45:memory && npm run test:v50:prototype && npm run test:v50:agent",
    "test:v45:memory": "node --import tsx scripts/v45-memory-policy-smoke.ts",
    "test:v50:prototype": "node --import tsx scripts/v50-home-prototype-smoke.ts",
    "test:v50:agent": "node --import tsx scripts/v50-agent-state-smoke.ts"
  },
  "dependencies": {
    "@ai-sdk/openai": "4.0.36",
    "@ai-sdk/openai-compatible": "3.0.27",
    "@pdf-lib/fontkit": "1.1.1",
    "@phosphor-icons/react": "2.1.10",
    "ai": "7.0.58",
    "leaflet": "1.9.4",
    "next": "16.2.11",
    "pdf-lib": "1.17.1",
    "qrcode": "1.5.4",
    "react": "19.2.8",
    "react-dom": "19.2.8",
    "zod": "4.4.3"
  },
  "devDependencies": {
    "@types/leaflet": "1.9.20",
    "@types/node": "^22",
    "@types/qrcode": "^1.5.5",
    "@types/react": "^19",
    "@types/react-dom": "^19",
    "tsx": "^4.20.6",
    "typescript": "^5.9"
  }
}
